summary.name: Repurpose.io
summary.one_liner: Repurpose.io is a hosted service that automatically reposts videos, Stories and images from one social media account to other platforms without manual uploads.
keywords: auto post videos to multiple platforms
use_cases: Repost one video to Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts
Share Instagram or Facebook Stories to other platforms
Automatically publish photos and carousels across channels
Manage posting for multiple client brands
Pull videos from TikTok or Instagram and publish them elsewhere without downloading
summary.what_it_does: Repurpose.io connects to social accounts through official APIs and pulls content from a source platform, such as TikTok or Instagram, then publishes it to selected destinations. The page says content is resized and has watermarks removed, and that captions stay intact. It supports videos, Stories (Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat, with TikTok listed as coming soon) and image posts including carousels. Supported platforms named include YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Snapchat, Pinterest, LinkedIn, X, Amazon, BlueSky, Twitch, Google Drive and Dropbox. Pricing tiers are set by the number of connected accounts and published videos per month.
notable: Connects via official platform APIs so users never share passwords
Pulls content from the source account and publishes automatically once workflows are set up, with no download or manual upload
Repurposes Instagram, Facebook and Snapchat Stories between platforms
Free tier allows publishing 10 videos with no credit card required
caveats: Paid plans listed at $35, $79 and $179 per month (USD) with higher account and publishing limits
Free trial is 14 days and users choose a plan when it ends
TikTok Story repurposing is listed as coming soon
